title: Da'awar Iko Mai Girma
intro: A zamanin da, wani mutum mai iko ya hau mulki a kan wata ƙasa mai faɗi da mazaunanta. Mulkin wannan mutum ya kasance cike da girman kai da kuma ƙalubale ga ikon Allah. Ku shirya don gano asalin rai wanda ƙaddararsa ta ƙarshe ta zama darasi mai ɗorewa ga dukkan tsararraki.
clues: Na yi mulki a kan wata babbar daula, inda kalmara doka ce.
Na ayyana kaina a matsayin allah mafi girma, ina buƙatar bauta daga duk wanda ke ƙarƙashin mulkina.
Na zalunci wata al'umma, na bautar da su kuma na ba da umarnin a kashe jarirai mazansu.
Sau da yawa wani manzon Allah mai tawali'u ya yi mini mu'ujizai bayyanannu a gabana da masu sihirina.
Na ƙi gaskiya da taurin kai, ina zargin manzon da sihiri da kuma shirin halaka shi da mabiyansa.
Ni da dukkan rundunonina mun shagaltu da teku yayin da muke bin waɗanda aka 'yantar daga hannuna ba tare da gajiyawa ba.

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An kiyaye jiki a matsayin alama
An ɗaukaka shi zuwa ga annabci
outcome.answer: An kiyaye jiki a matsayin alama

arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
